senses.definition: (of weather or a day) Featuring a lot of sunshine.
examples: Whilst it may be sunny today, the weather forecast is predicting rain.

senses.definition: (of a place) Receiving a lot of sunshine.
examples: the sunny side of a hill
I would describe Spain as sunny, but it's nothing in comparison to the Sahara.
a person with a sunny disposition

quotes.text: My decayed fair / A sunny look of his would soon repair.
